<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

The Moonlight-16B-A3B accuracy cases were migrated onto `NPUGSM8KMixin`, whose default GSM8K backend grades through the OpenAI completion API with 5-shot prompting. Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct scores only ~0.72 on that harness, while the 0.83 threshold was taken from the `evalscope` chat-template baseline (~0.837). As a result the nightly GSM8K runs fail deterministically (`nightly-2-npu-a3`: 0.7291, `nightly-4-npu-a3`: 0.7245) even though the model output is fine.

## Modifications

- `test_npu_mla_fia_hicache_bf16.py` and `TestDPAttentionMixedChunk` in `test_npu_dp_attention.py`: set `gsm8k_backend = "sgl_eval"` and `gsm8k_max_tokens = 4096` so these cases grade with the chat template, matching the harness the 0.83 baseline was measured with. The PR smoke path and the 3-attempt retry logic still come from the mixin and are unchanged.
- `npu_eval_accuracy_kit.py`: key `_is_pr_pipeline` on `GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF` instead of `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME`. `nightly-test-npu.yml` is itself triggered by `pull_request` through path filters, so the old check misclassified the nightly pipeline as the PR pipeline and silently downgraded the accuracy runs to the smoke request. An empty ref (local runs) is treated as non-PR so local behavior is unchanged.
- `test_npu_mla_fia_hicache_bf16.py` now imports `_is_pr_pipeline` from the mixin instead of duplicating the definition, matching the other NPU cases.
- `nightly-test-npu.yml`: gate every job except `nightly-2-npu-a3` and `nightly-4-npu-a3` on `github.event_name != 'pull_request'`, so a PR-triggered nightly run only exercises the two GSM8K suites instead of occupying every NPU runner. Scheduled, dispatched and reusable-workflow runs are unaffected.

## Accuracy Tests

Nightly GSM8K on Moonlight-16B-A3B, full 1319-question set:

| Harness | Accuracy | Threshold | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_eval` (completion, 5-shot) | 0.7291 / 0.7245 | 0.8217 | fail |
| `evalscope` (chat template), acc-2 suite | 0.853 | 0.8286 | pass |
| `sgl_eval` (chat template), this PR | pending nightly run | 0.8217 | - |

The 0.83 threshold is carried over as a starting point and annotated with a TODO; it will be re-calibrated from the first `sgl_eval` nightly result.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable, this is a test-only change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

 class NPUGSM8KMixin(GSM8KMixin):
-    """NPU GSM8K accuracy mixin — 1% tolerance + up to 3 retries."""
+    """NPU GSM8K accuracy mixin — 1% tolerance + up to 3 retries.
+
+    ``gsm8k_backend`` selects the harness:
+
+    * ``"run_eval"`` (default) / ``"sgl_eval"``: delegated to the parent.
+    * ``"evalscope"``: the NPU historical baseline harness (4-shot chat,
+      temperature 1.0). Use it to keep thresholds calibrated against the
+      legacy evalscope numbers (e.g. Moonlight bf16 tp2 = 0.837).
+    """
+
+    # evalscope request concurrency; 64 matches the harness the 0.83
+    # Moonlight baseline was calibrated with.
+    gsm8k_eval_batch_size = 64
+
+    def _test_gsm8k_evalscope(self, threshold):
+        from urllib.parse import urlparse
+
+        from sglang.test.ascend.e2e.test_npu_accuracy_utils import run_evalscope
+
+        parsed = urlparse(self.base_url)
+        # Match the historical evalscope baseline sampling: temperature 1.0
+        # with a generous token budget (gsm8k_max_tokens defaults to None).
+        generation_config = {
+            "temperature": (
+                self.gsm8k_temperature if self.gsm8k_temperature is not None else 1.0
+            ),
+            "max_tokens": self.gsm8k_max_tokens if self.gsm8k_max_tokens else 7168,
+        }
+        limit = (
+            self.gsm8k_num_examples if self.gsm8k_num_examples is not None else 100000
+        )
+        best = 0.0
+        for attempt in range(_NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS):
+            metrics = run_evalscope(
+                host=parsed.hostname,
+                port=parsed.port,
+                model=os.path.basename(self.model),
+                datasets=["gsm8k"],
+                limit=limit,
+                eval_batch_size=self.gsm8k_eval_batch_size,
+                generation_config=generation_config,
+            )
+            best = max(best, float(metrics.get("accuracy", 0.0)))
+            if best >= threshold:
+                print(f"gsm8k evalscope score={best:.4f} >= {threshold:.4f}")
+                return
+            if attempt < _NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS - 1:
+                print(
+                    f"[{type(self).__name__}] evalscope GSM8K attempt "
+                    f"{attempt + 1}/{_NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS} failed "
+                    f"(best={best:.4f} < {threshold:.4f}), retrying..."
+                )
+        raise AssertionError(
+            f"GSM8K evalscope accuracy {best} below threshold {threshold} "
+            f"after {_NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS} attempts"
+        )
+
+    def _resolve_relaxed_threshold(self) -> float:
+        """Return the GSM8K threshold with the NPU 1% tolerance applied.
+
+        ``gsm8k_score_threshold`` wins; the legacy ``gsm8k_accuracy_thres``
+        alias is used when it is unset (NaN). The relaxed value is cached, so
+        re-entering the test cannot compound the tolerance, and it is written
+        back to both attributes because the parent mixin reads it from there.
+        """
+        cached = getattr(self, "_npu_relaxed_threshold", None)
+        if cached is not None:
+            return cached
